programme.title: Que le spectacle commence
programme.desc: Carly est accusée pour une des sottises de Sam. Madame Briggs leur fait alors organiser les essais pour les nouveaux talents. Avec l'aide de Freddie, ils filment les auditions.

programme.title: Jadore Jack
programme.desc: Carly craque sur un garçon à l'école nommé Jake. Il est cool et sexy. Puisqu'elle l'aime bien, elle l'invite à auditionner sur son site. Malheureusement, elle comprend un peu tard que Jake est le pire chanteur du monde !

programme.title: Recherche Téléspectateurs
programme.desc: Carly et Sam se battent contre Freddie et Spencer pour décider de qui aura le meilleur plan pour rameuter les foules sur iCarly. La situation dégénère quand tous leur plans tournent à la catastrophe.

programme.title: Nevelocity
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie veulent qu'une critique de leur émission soit faite sur "Nevelocity", un site très populaire qui poste des critiques sur d'autres sites et émissions en ligne.

programme.title: Carly veut rester avec Spencer
programme.desc: Le grand-père de Carly et Spencer leur fait une visite surprise. Il est préoccupé par le fait que Spencer soit trop irresponsable et fainéant pour être le tuteur de Carly.

programme.title: Espionnage
programme.desc: Carly décide de faire une émission montrant ce que font les méchants profs quand ils ne sont pas à l'école. Elle décide de suivre son prof principal, Miss Briggs, mais se retrouve piégée avec Freddie dans l'appartement de Miss Briggs.

programme.title: Champion du monde
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie essayent de battre le record du monde de l'émission du web la plus longue. Pour ce faire, iCarly doit durer plus de 24h d'affilée...

programme.title: Freddie a une copine
programme.desc: Une fan d'iCarly, Valerie, demande à Freddie de sortir avec elle. Leur relation se passe si bien que Freddie commence à filmer la propre émission de Valerie.

programme.title: Naissance dun artiste
programme.desc: Carly invite l'idole de Spencer, Harry Joyner, pour qu'il puisse admirer son œuvre. Quand Harry qualifie son travail d'amateur, Spencer a le sentiment que sa vie n'avait plus de but.

programme.title: La plus grande des fans
programme.desc: La plus grande fan d'iCarly, Mandy, est invitée sur le plateau de l'émission comme seul public. Mandy s'avèrera être plus une traqueuse qu'une fan, et les enfants vont vite vouloir s'en débarrasser...

programme.title: Poussins.com
programme.desc: Carly et Sam cherchent à féconder des poules pour leur projet de sciences. Mais les poules s'échappent de l'incubateur...

programme.title: Je ne veux pas dembrouilles
programme.desc: Carly fabrique pour Sam un unique T-shirt iCarly pour commémorer l'anniversaire de leur amitié. Mais quand Sam échange le t-shirt contre des billets de concert, les deux amies se disputent.

programme.title: On peut toujours rêver
programme.desc: iCarly demande à ses fans d'envoyer des vidéos d'eux-mêmes pratiquant leur plus belle danse. Carly, Sam et Freddie recoivent plus de 3000 vidéos et se retrouvent à veiller toute la nuit pour les regarder.

programme.title: Joyeux Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie tournent iCarly dans un appartement prétendument hanté. Quand des choses étranges se mettent à se passer, les amis se demandent si les rumeurs de fantômes ne sont pas fondées...

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer sauve la vie du chanteur de The Plain White T's et le convainc de participer à iCarly. Mais des choses étranges se mettent à arriver sur le plateau et l'on se rend vite compte que c'est Nevel qui essaye de saboter iCarly...

programme.title: Jai été collée
programme.desc: Sam est punie la nuit de la cinquantième émission d'iCarly. Inapte à faire l'enregistrement, Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour être punis à leur tour afin de diffuser l'émission durant la nuit, avec Sam.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: Une souche mutante de piranhas géants et féroces s'échappe de l'Amazonie et se fraie un chemin vers la Floride.

programme.title: SuperGrid
programme.desc: Dans un avenir où une peste a infecté une grande partie de la population deux frères sont chargés de se rendre au Canada pour récupérer un mystérieux colis.

programme.title: Pterodactyl
programme.desc: Un volcan endormi au cœur de la forêt turque renferme un secret mortel. Parfaitement conservés, des oeufs de ptérodactyle sont prêts à éclore...

programme.title: Le Requin Mutant
programme.desc: Les invités d'un mariage sur une île doivent faire face à un requin à six têtes qui attaque l'île.

programme.title: Far away: les soldats de l'espoir
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Jun Shik travaille à la ferme du grand-père de Tatsuo alors que la Corée est colonisée par le Japon, mais il rêve de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Tokyo en tant que coureur de marathon. Tatsuo vise également à devenir marathonien, ce qui crée une rivalité entre eux. Mais la guerre éclate et ils sont tous deux forcés de s'enrôler dans l'armée. Tatsuo devient chef de la défense dans l'unité de Jun Shik et élabore un plan qui échoue. Jun Shik et Tatsuo sont capturés par les Soviétiques. Ils s'échappent mais sont rapidement capturés par les Allemands et forcés de se séparer. En 1944, ils se retrouvent sur les plages de Normandie.

programme.title: L'Amour au pied du sapin
programme.desc: Le plan était facile, le travail ne l'était pas. Par une nuit enneigée, une équipe serrée de quatre criminels planifie un vol de routine. Lorsque les choses tournent mal, l'amitié, la loyauté et la confiance sont poussées à leur paroxysme.

programme.title: Un Rêve de Noël
programme.desc: C'est bientôt Noël et Paula et sa famille ont des difficultés financières. Après une chute, la jeune femme se réveille dans une réalité alternative dans laquelle son mari est son riche ex petit ami mais Paula réalise bien vite que tout ce qu'elle souhaite pour Noël est de retrouver son ancienne vie.

programme.title: La Voleuse De Noël
programme.desc: Peu avant Noël, Kate Dove et son complice sont filmés en plein braquage. Malheureusement, Kate avait enlevé sa cagoule au moment d'ouvrir le coffre-fort, et tous les journaux télévisés se sont aussitôt mis à passer sa photo en boucle.

programme.title: Je ne suis pas prête pour Noël
programme.desc: La vie agitée de Holly axée sur sa carrière déraille quand elle découvre qu'elle ne peut plus mentir à cause d'un vœu que sa nièce Anna a fait au père Noël.

programme.title: Puppy Star Christmas
programme.desc: La famille Pup Star vient de s'agrandir ! Et les nouveaux chiots : Cindy, Rosie, Charlie et Brody vont apprendre ce que Noël signifie vraiment. Lorsque la méchante bande de Pup Star complote de ruiner Noël ...

programme.title: Metal Hunter
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un groupe de vétérans des Marines dérobe un chargement d'armes militaires, il réveille sans le savoir une machine à tuer de la Guerre froide. Programmé pour accomplir sa mission à tout prix, ce robot impitoyable les traque sans relâche. Fuir est inutile. Survivre est impossible.

programme.title: Gacy
programme.desc: John Wayne Gacy est un citoyen modèle. Il ne rate jamais une occasion d'organiser une fête pour ses amis ou de se déguiser en clown pour amuser les enfants. Mais derrière cette façade trop idéale se cache un monstre. Gacy a tué 30 personnes, dont la plupart sont enterrées autour de sa maison.

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: Inspiré de faits réels. Le 12 août 1967, dans le parc national de Glacier au Montana, l'impensable se produit : la même nuit, à 15 km d'intervalle, surviennent non pas une, mais deux attaques mortelles de grizzli.

programme.title: Dark Game
programme.desc: Un détective se lance dans une course contre la montre pour arrêter un jeu télévisé sur le dark web, où les captifs sont forcés de s'affronter pour rester en vie.

programme.title: Suicide Tourist
programme.desc: Condamné par une maladie incurable, un détective enquête dans un hôtel où les clients viennent mettre fin à leurs jours. Une affaire énigmatique qui l'oblige à affronter sa propre mortalité.

programme.title: Paix sur la terre
programme.desc: La nuit tombe quelque part sur la terre. Ca et là, des ovoïdes traversent le ciel et s'abattent sur le sol. Peu après, on retrouve des sièges vides et des cannes à pêche plantées dans l'herbe... Tout devient extrêmement calme.

programme.title: Fugue
programme.desc: Un petit bonhomme tout à fait quelconque veut prendre soin d'une jeune pousse en la mettant au soleil. Dans un filet, il capture un nuage pour pouvoir abreuver la plante, mais celui-ci, se transformant en eau, glisse au travers des mailles. Le petit bonhomme tentera par tous les moyens de rattraper ce filet d'eau indispensable au bien-être de sa plante.

programme.title: Les yeux de la tête
programme.desc: John, un grand acteur américain, alors qu'il joue amicalement un trou au golf en France, reçoit une balle en pleine figure et perd un oeil. Il peut cependant compter sur l'excellence de la médecine européenne et l'émergence de l'économie chinoise...

programme.title: Le printemps de Bernard
programme.desc: Bernard travaille à la patinoire municipale depuis toujours, mais il s'ennuie de plus en plus, il a froid. Un soir, en rentrant chez lui, il surprend une sculpture d'athlète en bronze en train de sortir de la douche. Au tour d'un plat de nouilles propices à toutes les confidences, ils se découvrent un rêve en commun : partir à la mer.

programme.title: C'est fini avec Loïc
programme.desc: Mélanie est une comédienne heureuse. Elle doit rencontrer aujourd'hui le réalisateur qu'elle admire le plus au monde. Mais le comportement de ce dernier va transformer le (son?) rêve en cauchemar...

programme.title: La nouvelle musique
programme.desc: Dans un univers semblable au nôtre, il n'existe qu'un seule musique. Appelé “la musique”, cette suite d'accords berce l'humanité depuis des siècles. Pour Tom, bientôt au chômage, cette suite est devenue insupportable.

programme.title: À cheval dans une maison vide
programme.desc: Au cours d'un voyage d'une journée, un adulte et un adolescent vont voir leur vie durablement modifiée. L'un est un éducateur spécialisé, l'autre est un adolescent sortant juste de prison.

programme.title: Chronique panoramique
programme.desc: Tous ces gens silencieux dans le train, qui sont-ils vraiment et à quoi peuvent-ils bien réfléchir en ce moment même ?

programme.title: Marche forcée
programme.desc: A l'occasion d'une classe verte dans les Cévennes, Lucas, professeur de français dans un lycée de banlieue, surprend deux de ses élèves, Samia et Djome, à l'écart en train de fumer de l'herbe mais bientôt le trio se perd dans le paysage de rivières et de forêts sauvages...

Après un séisme, un homme se réveille emprisonné dans les décombres. Lorsque tout espoir semble perdu, il découvre qu'il n'est pas seul, une autre personne est prisonnière. Ensemble, ils vont tenter de survivre à cette situation désespérée.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Ena, femme pompière passionnée, est très investie dans son métier. Sa fascination pour le feu l'épanouie autant qu'elle impacte sur sa vie familiale.

programme.title: Mémo
programme.desc: Louis, retraité, veut à tout prix garder son indépendance face à la surprotection de sa fille Nina.

programme.title: J'aime beaucoup ta mère
programme.desc: Stéphane, quarante ans, une ancienne petite terreur du collège rend visite à sa mère. Celle-ci doit lui présenter son nouveau compagnon : Martin Mollard, sa tête de turc du collège….

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: Ni vu ni connu
programme.desc: Embauché par une femme qui se pense trompée, pour kidnapper et corriger la maîtresse de son mari, un escroc à la petite semaine met au point avec une de ses connaissances une combine pour empocher facilement l'argent. Mais le jour de la confrontation, les choses prennent un tour inattendu.

programme.title: Il faut qu'on parle
programme.desc: Nous avons tous quitté un jour, un(e) conjoint(e) sans raisons valables, si ce n'est l'envie de passer à autre chose. Et bien c'est ce que va faire le personnage d'Adam. Mais l'annonce de sa décision ne va pas se passer comme prévue…

programme.title: Où elle est maman ?
programme.desc: Roberto, Pablo et Sacha sont trois frères. Il y a quelques jours ils viennent de perdre leur maman. Leur papa, Joseph, semble ne pas se préoccuper de la situation. Pour lui, son épouse est encore là. C'est dans cet étrange contexte que les trois hommes vont devoir accompagner leur père dans cet instant difficile, de la marche funèbre à cette nuit où il va disparaître.

programme.title: Underwater
programme.desc: Jeanne Clairsen, "Oreille d'Or" dans la marine, est appelée par le Commissaire Delattre, afin qu'elle perce tous les bruits qui apporteraient la preuve qu'une nouvelle victime est bien détenue chez le suspect qu'ils ont mis sur écoute.

programme.title: Yùl et le serpent
programme.desc: Yùl, treize ans, accompagne son grand frère Dino pour conclure un deal avec Mike, petite frappe accompagnée de son dogue argentin. Alors que la situation tourne mal, un étrange serpent apparaît.

programme.title: À demi mot
programme.desc: Quand Laurène et Sacha se réveillent dans les bras l'un de l'autre, leur amour semble être une évidence, jusqu'à ce que les mots viennent s'immiscer dans leur histoire.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Dans le nez
programme.desc: “Dans le nez” est une histoire d'amour, de dégoût et de chimie volatile. Un conte où les montagnes sont des flacons, les aisselles des sources et les fantômes des parfums.

programme.title: Braise
programme.desc: Lors d'une soirée bien arrosée, un jeune homme trompe sa copine avec une jolie et exubérante Anglaise. Trois de leurs amis observent et commentent cette aventure. Un parallèle se crée entre cette conversation et l'étreinte des deux amants.

programme.title: L'amour libre
programme.desc: Dans un café parisien, deux bonnes amies, l'une célibataire et l'autre en union libre, se réunissent pour faire le point sur leur vie et leurs amours.

programme.title: Papa oom mow mow
programme.desc: Rouen, 1986. Par ennui, par amour, par opportunité (ou par miracle), Frank subit un choc capillaire, qui change sa triste vie dans sa pluvieuse ville...

programme.title: Gandahar
programme.desc: Gandahar, paisible oasis au cour d'une galaxie agitée, est menacée par une force terrible et mystérieuse.

programme.title: Devenir Colette
programme.desc: Ce film retrace l'adolescence de la célèbre romancière jusqu'à ce qu'elle devienne Colette et s'affranchisse de son mari, un éditeur opportuniste qui n'hésitera pas à s'attribuer la paternité de son premier succès littéraire.

programme.title: The Women
programme.desc: Mary est mariée à Stephen Haines, un homme d'affaires new-yorkais. Fidèle à son époux et mère d'une fillette, elle est entourée d'"amies", dont Sylvia Fowler, la comtesse DeLave, et Miriam Aarons, qui savent quelque chose qu'elle ignore : son mari la trompe avec Crystal Allen, une vendeuse arriviste...

programme.title: Point De Chute
programme.desc: Trois voyous enlèvent une jeune fille de quinze ans, Patricia, pour obtenir de son père le versement d'une rançon. Ils la séquestrent dans une cabane perdue au bord de la mer et la battent. Seul Eddie, un jeune voyou, gardien de la jeune fille, s'insurge contre ces méthodes. A travers un fait divers tragique, le portrait de deux adolescents dans un climat d'angoisse et de violence.

programme.title: Cent Jours A Palerme
programme.desc: Au printemps 1982, le général Dalla Chiesa affiche de brillants états de service après avoir réussi à vaincre les Brigades rouges. Alors qu'il pourrait partir à la retraite, satisfait du devoir accompli, et mener une vie paisible aux côtés de sa compagne Emanuela, il accède à un dernier poste. Il accepte la charge de Préfet à Palerme, une ville contrôlée par la Mafia sicilienne. Peu de temps après son arrivée, le député communiste Pio La Torre est éliminé par Cosa Nostra. Révolté par ce crime et la corruption ambiante, Dalla Chiesa sera désormais la bête noire des parrains du crime. Ces derniers sont bien décidés à lui barrer la route. Lino Ventura excelle en justicier sans peur et sans reproches dans ce drame politique inspiré de faits authentiques.

programme.title: Minamata
programme.desc: Le photographe de guerre W. Eugene Smith retourne au Japon où il documente l'effet dévastateur de l'empoisonnement au mercure dans les communautés côtières.

programme.title: The Interview
programme.desc: Dave et son équipe ils découvrent que le dirigeant nord-coréen Kim Jong-un est un fan de leur show...

programme.title: The Words
programme.desc: Rory Jansen, jeune auteur new-yorkais, rejeté par les maisons d'édition, peine à lancer sa carrière. En voyage de noces à Paris, son épouse Dora lui offre un porte-documents chiné chez un brocanteur.

programme.title: Le Livre de l'Amour
programme.desc: Henry et Penny vivent à la Nouvelle-Orléans et forment un couple très amoureux, jusqu'à ce que la tragédie frappe. Henry est alors contraint de se reconstruire. Après s'être lié d'amitié avec une adolescente à la rue revêche, il décide de l'aider à construire un radeau pour traverser l'Atlantique.

programme.title: Le prince et moi
programme.desc: Paige découvre avec stupeur que l'homme dont elle est tombée amoureuse est un prince. Les choses se compliquent lorsque le roi renonce à son rôle et force alors son amoureux à prendre le trône. Paige doit maintenant prendre une décision difficile : suivre sa carrière ou son cœur.

programme.title: Held Up
programme.desc: Ce qui devait être une escapade romantique se transforme en une série de déboires désopilants. La femme de Michael l'abandonne dans le désert, où il se fait voler sa voiture par un adolescent et se retrouve pris en otage lors du braquage d'un magasin.

programme.title: Le dernière passe
programme.desc: Un perdant d'une petite ville est déterminé à avoir une autre chance de gagner un match de football.

programme.title: Le prince et moi
programme.desc: Paige découvre avec stupeur que l'homme dont elle est tombée amoureuse est un prince. Les choses se compliquent lorsque le roi renonce à son rôle et force alors son amoureux à prendre le trône. Paige doit maintenant prendre une décision difficile : suivre sa carrière ou son cœur.

programme.title: Alfie
programme.desc: Quand les conséquences de son style de vie de playboy commencent à affecter les femmes de sa vie et son meilleur ami (Omar Epps), Alfie se demande si l'existence se réduit à ces histoires d'amours fugaces ou s'il y a autre chose.

programme.title: Leçons de Vie
programme.desc: L'arrivée de Michael D'Angelo, surnommé “Mr. D”, déplaît au doyen Matt Warner, qui vise le titre de meilleur enseignant. Leur rivalité finit cependant par profiter aux élèves.

programme.title: John and the Hole
programme.desc: John ressemble à tous les collégiens de son âge. En famille aussi, il se sent bien… Un jour, il découvre au fond de son jardin un vieux bunker. Contre toute attente, il décide d'y enfermer sa sœur et ses parents après les avoir sédatés.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: Dans le futur, les humains vivent aux côtés de robots de compagnie, les Mechas. Mais lorsque David, un prototype d'enfant robot, est programmé pour donner un amour inconditionnel, sa famille humaine n'est pas prête à en subir les conséquences.

programme.desc: C'est un peu l'impasse dans la vie des amies de toujours Kate (Mamrie Hart), Evie (Grace Helbig) et Charlie (Hannah Hart). A la veille de son trentième anniversaire, Kate accepte de laisser Evie et Charlie lui organiser une fête.

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: L'une des filles du «Paradiso» sombre dans le coma après avoir prétendument fait une chute dans les escaliers. Hannah et son équipe se retrouvent confrontés à un cas épineux. En effet, entre son proxénète, avide d'argent, et les clients de l'établissement, nombreux sont les coupables potentiels…

programme.title: L'homme de ma vie et moi
programme.desc: Niki anime un podcast bien connu sur les relations amoureuses. Lorsqu'un grand éditeur la contacte pour un éventuel contrat de livre, elle se retrouve en difficulté car le podcast est basé sur sa relation avec un petit ami imaginaire, Monsieur Parfait. Elle a besoin d'un remplaçant...

programme.title: Team Bride
programme.desc: Hannah McKenzie gère une activité secondaire de création de robes de mariée lorsqu'elle n'est pas occupée par son travail au salon. Lorsque Will Millington, héritier de l'empire du mariage, arrive avec l'intention de redynamiser la marque, ils se retrouvent à travailler ensemble et peut-être même à tomber amoureux...

programme.title: Ava
programme.desc: Ava, 13 ans, apprend qu'elle perdra la vue plus tôt que ce qu'elle espérait, et affronte le problème à sa manière.

programme.title: Vice
programme.desc: Vice est un resort dans lequel les personnes peuvent assouvir leurs fantasmes.

programme.title: Sortie Mortelle
programme.desc: Des inconnus sont piégés dans une maison où un événement terrible a eu lieu il y a 100 ans.

programme.title: Pas de Chance
programme.desc: Archie est un escroc engagé par un propriétaire de parc d'attractions pour assassiner sa femme.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Transfert
programme.desc: L'ex-CIA est déterminée à comprendre ce qui est arrivé à son mari, grièvement blessé lors d'une mission.

programme.title: La Parade de Noël
programme.desc: Charlotte tente de raviver la tradition du défilé de trains de Noël pour son fils Benny. Avec l'aide du professeur de ce dernier, elle redécouvre l'esprit des fêtes… malgré des secrets du passé.

programme.title: Noël sous les sapins
programme.desc: Kyla est une généalogiste chevronnée qui a bâti une entreprise florissante en reconstituant des arbres généalogiques. Lorsqu'elle découvre de nouvelles informations concernant la mystérieuse famille élargie de sa mère, elle et sa sœur se rendent dans la charmante ville de Conifer, espérant reconstituer leurs origines. Leurs recherches mènent Kyla à une exploitation de sapins de Noël familiale depuis des générations, à son propriétaire têtu mais séduisant… et, qui sait, peut-être à l'amour.

programme.title: Une manucure parfaite
programme.desc: Katya, inventrice originale, s'associe à Ryan, consultant charismatique, pour présenter son invention au salon de la beauté. Entre tensions, ambitions et romance, leur partenariat devient explosif.

programme.title: Le gala de l'amour
programme.desc: Katie, organisatrice d'événements talentueuse, doit gérer le prestigieux Garden Gala de sa mère. Entre un paysagiste difficile et la pression familiale, elle se retrouve plongée dans un inattendu triangle amoureux.

programme.title: Chair De Poule
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon déménage avec sa mère et sa soeur dans la petite ville de Greendale, dans le Maryland. Sur place, il rencontre l'écrivain RL Stine, auteur à succès de romans d'épouvante pour adolescents…

programme.title: Chair de Poule 2
programme.desc: Ne soyez pas trop curieux ! Pour préparer la brocante de l'école, deux meilleurs amis : Sonny et Sam, sont en quête de trésors qu'auraient précipitamment abandonnés les gens dans leurs ordures. Mais après avoir passé au crible la vielle maison de M. Stine, ils ouvrent un livre jusqu'à lors scellé qui libère un cauchemar surnaturel : Slappy ! Une course contre la montre s'engage alors, avec l'aide de Sarah la sœur de Sonny, ils vont tout mettre en œuvre pour tenter de ramener le Pantin maléfique et tous les monstres qu'il a ressuscité à l'intérieur du livre, avant qu'il ne répande un chaos total...

programme.title: Une Équipe Hors Du Commun
programme.desc: La seconde guerre mondiale déclarée, les joueurs professionels de Base-Ball partent au front. Afin de sauver les clubs et le sport, des propriétaires de clubs s'associent pour créer une ligue de base-ball féminine.

programme.title: Annie (2014)

Mais Annie rêve toujours de rencontrer ses vrais parents, disparus dans un incendie des années plus tôt et dont elle ignore le décès. Ce qui va inciter un couple de truands, Rooster et Lily, appâtés par une promesse de récompense et encouragés par Miss Hannigan, la sœur de Rooster, à se faire passer pour les parents de la petite.

programme.title: Kids in America
programme.desc: Quand le principal d'un lycée abuse de son pouvoir pour restreindre la liberté d'expression à l'intérieur de l'établissement, un groupe de sept jeunes, encouragés par un professeur passionné, s'allient pour protester contre l'hypocrisie de leur administration.

programme.title: Big Mamma 2
programme.desc: Un agent du FBI déguisé en vieille dame devient nounou chez un suspect.

programme.title: Un plan d'enfer

programme.title: Flashbacks of a Fool
programme.desc: Joe Scot, une ancienne star hollywoodienne est plongé dans un brouillard de sexe et de drogues.

programme.title: Chris McCausland: My Body Rests But My Brain Doesn't!
programme.desc: Comedian Chris McCausland chats with Fearne Cotton about holidays and travel. Chris explains how losing his sight has changed the way he approaches holidays, from planning activities and communicating in foreign countries to managing his dependence on loved ones. He discusses getting into his daughter's favourite holiday hobby: rollercoasters.

programme.title: Ant & Dec On Anxiety, Gratitude & Turning 50
programme.desc: In their first ever podcast appearance, Ant and Dec join Fearne and explain that nearly four decades into their careers they're still laughing together just as much as they did at the beginning, but now they've got far more gratitude for each day they get to be on TV.

programme.title: Caitlin Moran On How She Finally Calmed Her Nervous System
programme.desc: Writer Caitlin Moran discusses her 30-year battle with anxiety that began at age 13, and how she's now two years anxiety-free through choosing to be hopeful and see the good in life. She talks with Fearne Cotton about how social media has altered our perception of reality, the difference between posting angrily online and taking real-world action, social anxiety when meeting friends, and how presuming everyone's having a bad day can make you happier.

programme.title: Ashley Roberts On Coping With Anxiety And Insomnia
programme.desc: Ashley Roberts discusses her journey through burnout and body shaming during the height of the Pussycat Dolls' fame, and how discovering breathwork helped her recover from intense anxiety and physical ill-health. She talks about her mental health toolkit, the grief of losing her dad to suicide, and family mental illness. With Fearne Cotton, she shares experiences of insomnia and coping strategies.

programme.title: Adam Kay Opens Up About The PTSD That Made Him Leave The NHS
programme.desc: Former doctor Adam Kay discusses the traumatic day at work that left him with PTSD and led to his decision to leave the NHS. He explains how the experience affected his mental health, leaving him feeling paranoid and overcautious, and how he turned to diary writing to process his emotions. Adam and Fearne discuss mental health stigma in the workplace and at home, and offer advice for building mental health toolkits for crises of varying severity. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicide.

programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz

programme.title: The Geography Elimination Quiz

programme.title: Joe Pub Quiz with Eddie Hall & Expressions
programme.desc: Eddie Hall and Expressions take on a quiz about the Sidemen, Gen Z slang, old-school phrases, and iconic Sidemen quotes. programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!

The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: Hugh Jackman Takes On The Irish Test
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman steps up to the ultimate Irish test, trying his hand at making a proper Irish breakfast with mixed results, sharing thoughts on Ryan Reynolds, and tackling classic Irish challenges. Expect plenty of laughs and chaos as Hugh takes on various Irish cultural tasks.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. Do they know what a spicebag is? Can they tell the difference between real and fake Irish sayings? And can they identify some iconic Irish people?

programme.title: Gen Z Watch Little Britain, Fat Families & Jeremy Kyle For The First Time
programme.desc: Gen Z watches Little Britain, Fat Families, and The Jeremy Kyle Show for the first time and gives their honest reactions to some of the most unhinged British television ever made. From outrageous sketches to brutal reality TV moments, they explore whether it was funny, uncomfortable, or both.

programme.title: Chris Pratt Takes On The British Test
programme.desc: Chris Pratt takes on the ultimate British test as he attempts some of the UK's most iconic accents. From London to the North, see how well he really knows British voices and culture.

programme.title: Chris O'Dowd Plays Time Capsule
programme.desc: Chris O'Dowd becomes the first guest to take on the brand new Time Capsule format, building a personal capsule with items connected to his life, career, childhood and biggest memories. He discusses Bridesmaids sequel talk and possible MCU ambitions, the Dublin versus London debate, and shares stories and nostalgic moments throughout.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Average Joe
programme.desc: Average Joe speaks with workers from the Galway Rape Crisis Centre about their free services. They discuss the importance of listening and believing survivors of sexual violence, the role of art therapy in supporting trauma processing, and why you don't need the right words or a label to reach out for help. t.

programme.title: Will Arnett & John Bishop Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Hollywood star Will Arnett and British comedian John Bishop take on the ultimate British Test. From debating if British people are polite to sampling classic British food, tea etiquette, and slang — this duo delivers laughs, charm, and plenty of friendly rivalry. Who's the real British expert? programme.title: Why We Should Abolish Politicians
programme.desc: Yale political scientist Hélène Landemore, author of Politics Without Politicians, argues that the political systems we take for granted are no longer fit for purpose. As trust in politicians reaches historic lows across Britain, Europe and the United States, Landemore makes the case that elections alone may no longer be enough to produce governments that truly represent ordinary people.

programme.title: Goth Bride
programme.desc: They say anything goes in Hollywood, but wedding planner David Tutera is shocked to find out that bride Christina wants a wedding based on black. And she means it – Christina shows David a black bridal gown, black bridesmaids' dresses and finally a tiny black flower girl dress for her darling seven-year old daughter! Even her fiancé Eric tells David the wedding should be black, dark and creepy to fit their all-goth fashion style! David finds himself surrounded by enough skeletons, skulls and spiders to decorate a Halloween party, but nothing in wedding white. And when he takes Christina to a bridal shop filled with white dresses, she nearly has an anxiety attack! David has to find out just what makes this adorable goth bride tick, and when he does, he delivers a high-fashion, romantic wedding that's perfect for Christina.

programme.title: Fashionista Bride
programme.desc: Wedding planner David Tutera meets a bride whose passion for fashion is so extreme, that she spent most of her budget on a designer dress and shoes, leaving the rest of her wedding behind. This shopaholic bride is even confused about her theme - she wants a frivolous, flouncy Marie-Antoinette look with some rustic birch logs and confetti thrown in for good measure! David comes to the rescue of this good-hearted fashionista and turns her wedding into a runway success.

programme.title: Tuscany Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera loves Tuscany, Italy, and so does his latest bride Jane. She wants a romantic outdoor wedding, but her vision of what Tuscany looks like is more than a little skewed, and her bright orange bridesmaid's dresses are only adding to the disaster. Worst of all, the bride, the groom, and the father-of-the-bride just lost their jobs and the wedding plans are going up in smoke. David Tutera will need all his skill and savvy to create the perfect Tuscan wedding in southern California.

programme.title: Dragonfly Bride
programme.desc: Bride Regina lost a child and wants a dragonfly-themed wedding as a symbol of hope. David Tutera has his work cut out for him, having to convince the bride that she deserves every part of the gorgeous garden wedding he's creating. The wedding dress Regina bought on sale is already frayed, and the bridesmaid's dresses are all different shades of green -- David's least favorite color for fashion. What's more, Regina and her fiancé are planning a backyard wedding with no food for the guests! David has one surprise after another for this sweet-natured bride, culminating in an emotional fairy-tale wedding with larger-than-life entertainment.

programme.title: Hollywood Glam Bride
programme.desc: Bride Benita is an actress that wants a Hollywood glam wedding, but she's procrastinated on all the details. Her decorations are better suited to a child's birthday party, and the bridesmaids' dresses remind wedding planner David Tutera of a tube sock! He sees none of the Old Hollywood glitz and glam Benita and her actor fiancé Arlen say they want. David decides to take his bride and groom back in time, trying on wedding fashions from the forties, fifties, and sixties. Can he pull together a swinging, classy affair in time for this bride and groom to say I do?

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: My Secret,Terrius Ep.4 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. While doing something no one asked her to at her new job, she finds out a secret of the Korean office of Cornerstone, an international military industrial complex. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). She grows rapidly within the world of intelligence, which had seemed like a totally different world to her, and shows great performance that even surprises the NIS agents.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.3
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest

Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Between Denmark and Latvia
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest on earth and didn't evolve until after the last Ice Age. It seems so familiar, yet offers many surprises. The shores of the Baltic Sea are still shaped by wind and waves. The first episode takes us from Denmark's northernmost corner, via the Darss Peninsula in Germany and Lithuania's Curonian Spit to the endless beaches of Latvia. The film begins at the gateway to the Baltic Sea at Denmark's northernmost point: Skagen. It is here that the North Sea and the Baltic Sea meet and form a divide made of sand between Skagerrak and Kattegat. In June, hundreds of seals gather together on the lonely island of Anholt between Denmark and Sweden. It is the largest seal colony in the Baltic Sea. No camera team has ever been able to get so close to the animals as nature filmmaker Christoph Hauschild. Using remote-control cameras, he and his team have been able to capture intimate images of the way the seals live over and beneath water. For the very first time they follow a mother with her young to swimming lessons and in doing so, capture very emotional moments of these timid creatures. Most of the freshwater from the North Sea to the Baltic Sea, flows through the Store Baelt. In this sound, the underwater world is characterised by many species of saltwater loving fish. In the waters around Sjaelland, the largest stocks of harbour porpoise in the Baltic Sea. In 2016, the labyrinth of islands, sounds and fjords attracted two dolphins. They spent several months in the fjords of Flensburg and Kiel. Astounding images: they show familiar to us from the Mediterranean, but not something we would necessarily expect from the Baltic Sea.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 1st episode of the ARTE series "Adventure Turkey" shows the Mediterranean region: blossoming orchards, olive groves and "still" untouched nature frame historical treasures. In this environment, tradition and modernity engage in a daily confrontation. Is it better to preserve old craft traditions? Can they be brought into the modern age? Sabine Howe meets women who are swimming free, men who are clinging on - but above all people who are trying anew every day to resolve this question for themselves.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 2nd episode starts in Central Anatolia, goes through Cappadocia and ends near the Syrian border. Those who set off from Antalya on the coast inland will reach Isparta. In the rose-growing region, author Nadja Frenz is intoxicated by the intense scent of the Damascene rose, in Konya she meets the dancing Dervishes and discovers the fairytale landscape of Cappadocia. The journey ends with homemade liqueurs in Samandağ, where Christians, Jews, Alewites and Sunnis still live in peaceful harmony - just a few kilometers from the Syrian border.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: In episode 3, the journey goes to the almost forgotten region of Eastern Anatolia, which borders Armenia, Iran, Iraq and Syria. Accordingly, different cultures and religions mix here. The landscape is characterized by magnificent mountain ranges and endless steppes. Most people here live very simply, with sheep and goats adapted to the barren conditions and dry climate. The predominantly Kurdish society is still traditionally organized, with clear roles for women and men.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 4th episode takes us along the Black Sea coast. Author Claudia Wallbrecht uncovers the secret of the Tulum, a very special type of bagpipe, and accompanies a forest beekeeper on breakneck climbing adventures in the name of honey. The eastern Black Sea region borders on Georgia and Armenia, and here cultures, languages and ethnic groups have been mixing for centuries: for example, Hemşin, Lasen and the descendants of Pontic Greeks. They all shape the region - and this episode - with their music, architecture, food and ancient customs.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 5th part of "Adventure Turkey" throws itself into the middle of the hustle and bustle of Istanbul! Against the backdrop of the Golden Horn and the Bosphorus, the Arte team experiences lonely hearts in search of connection, spraying artists who make the city more colorful, calligraphers who preserve the old. They meet modern women with creative minds and conservative women with creative minds, fathom coffee law reading and get intoxicated by Fasil singing.

programme.title: The Black Sea Coast
programme.desc: This coast offers everything: golden sandy beaches in the south, a spectacular water labyrinth in the north. Romania and Bulgaria on the Black Sea: that is a mixture of centuries-old traditions, Eastern Bloc charm and modern Europe. Meet the people who give the region an unique face: horse rescuers, castle owners, shellfish breeders.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.sub-title: Rome: What are the tourists missing out on?
programme.desc: Italy is a vacationer's paradise. The food, the people, the sights and sounds, the history! But are the tourists doing it right when it comes to the trying out authentic food in Rome? Liesel embarks on a mission to explore the street food of the city. With the help of her food journalist buddy, Saverio de Luca, Liesel sifts through pasticceri, food festivals, touristed hotspots, all in an effort to understand real Roman food.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.sub-title: Emlia Romagna: What's the food like?
programme.desc: The region of Emilia Romagna is lush with gentle rolling hills where time honored ingredients like truffles, olives, and vast vineyards can be found. But this region is usually overshadowed by it's more famous neighboring cities, Florence and Venice. To understand the food of this region, Liesel explores the quaint sea-side town of Rimini and the hugely impressive Bologna. It's a tale of discovering local foodie passion that allows Liesel to hunt for truffles and try her hand in making her own gelato, a the world's only Gelato University!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.sub-title: Mexico: Tequila: Does it need to come from certain regions of Mexico?
programme.desc: In the land of tequila, Liesel gets the skinny on the premium export of Jalisco, blue agave tequila. From harvesting agave with the legendary jimadores, to understanding the process of distillation, Liesel is on the hunt to appreciate and understand the production requirements of this spirit that makes it what it is. Are they worth it only if they're from Jalisco or can they be made somewhere else for cheaper and better..? Liesel finds out!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.

programme.desc: Nick and Sally are having a sleepover in the treehouse and Nick is startled by a shadow. Then, Nick unintentionally loses Sally's bouncy ball.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally need a strong piece of string to pull their train but it breaks and they don't have anything stronger. Later, they notice a bird flying back and forth into the tree branches.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: Stephanie's Surprise Party
programme.desc: When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they soon discover that it's not easy keeping their plans secret from Stephanie who becomes suspicious when none of the girls have time to hang out. When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they discover that it's not easy keeping their plans a secret. As the girls choreograph a dance routine, magic show and search for the perfect present and cake, Stephanie becomes aware that her friends are avoiding her on her birthday and excluding her from their activities... Little does she know that her friends are secretly preparing a surprise pool party for her! Once the surprise is revealed Stephanie realises how much her friends care about her and the importance of friendship.

programme.title: Dolphin Cruise
programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. When Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a school science contest and win a Dolphin sight-seeing trip, not everything goes to plan...As the girls set out to sea on a luxury yacht, misunderstandings and disagreements occur which become secondary when they discover a pod of dolphins in danger. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

programme.title: Rise Of The Snakes
programme.desc: The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off. The Ninja dismiss him as a threat, but regret that choice after Lloyd wakes up the evil snake tribe. A prophecy is revealed that states a green ninja will ultimately defeat Lord Garmadon.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him and return to find that the snakes have burned it to the ground.

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. Can the NEXO-Knights bring order out of the chaos and save the King? Jestro finds the Book of Chaos in the countryside and decides he must feed it to the book. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.

The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.
